exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Battery path current: system load on the converter output and battery discharge returns through RCS (RCS = 0.05 / ICSMAX, 21 mOhm for 2.37 A), which gives -1.04 V across CSP-CSN at 49.7 A against the -0.3 to 0.3 V absolute maximum (LTC4020.pdf Rev. E, read 2026-10-02T11:52:03Z)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The 21 mOhm assumes ICSMAX equals the 2.37 A charge current. The RNG/SS pin (pin 15, 'effective range 0 to 1 V') reduces the maximum charge current to the fraction VRNG/SS of the current RCS programs (my reading of the same Rev. E, 2026-10-02T12:32:03Z), so RCS can be 4 mOhm (ICSMAX 12.5 A, RNG/SS about 0.19 V for 2.37 A) and CSP-CSN is 0.267 V at 66.8 A, inside 0.3 V. The reason names no requirement value the part misses once RCS is sized from the pack current. The stocked order code is C462630 (#TRPBF), 2648 on 2026-10-02T12:23:52Z; C2858365 reads 52.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: No BATFET ('BATFET Power Path No', SLUSE66A Device Comparison Table, round 1 reading 2026-09-29T10:12:57Z, not re-read): no power path
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: 'No BATFET' removes a switch, not the load sharing the rows ask for. Re-read at 2026-10-02T12:21:44Z: section 9.3.17 says the input source powers the system and the charge, charge current falls as the system load rises, and the battery supplements the load when VSYS falls below it; IBAT is read in discharge as 8 or 16 x (VSRN - VSRP); the 5 mOhm RSR is the POR setting; SRP-SRN is -0.5 to 0.5 V recommended (0.334 V at 66.8 A). IOBoard.md 'Not known' accepts 'a power path or load sharing'. Live stock 1125 (12:30:14Z) is above the gate; the part is not shown to miss any Pack charger or Power path value.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: The data sheet (read 2026-10-02T11:58:13Z) names no system output, NVDC path or power path: the converter output is the battery, so the bench cannot run from the pack while it charges
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: As stated the reason does not hold: the data sheet says to connect the system load 'directly in parallel to the battery pack' (MPPT note, section 6.3.5) and describes a system on the input side, so a load can run from the pack while charging. The part still fails on another value: RBAT_SNS is listed at 5 mOhm only and SRP with respect to SRN is -0.3 to 0.3 V absolute maximum, so 66.8 A gives 0.334 V (60 A gives 0.300 V, at the limit). Drop it on the sense range, not on the missing power path. Live stock of C22427194 116 (2026-10-02T12:09:51Z).

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Battery path current: RSR 10 or 20 mOhm only (RSNS_RSR bit), SRP-SRN 0.60 V at 60 A against -0.5 to 0.5 V (BQ25710/13) and 35 A at 10 mOhm against -0.35 to 0.35 V (BQ25703A/BQ25700A)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The bit only sets the scale of the IC's charge-current setting and IBAT readout (the BQ25710 and BQ25713 data sheets limit RAC and RSR to 10 and 20 mOhm only 'for proper PSYS functionality'); the requirement value is the SRP-SRN range. With a 5 mOhm shunt and RSNS_RSR = 0 (firmware doubles the register values) SRP-SRN is 0.334 V at 66.8 A, inside 0.35 V and 0.5 V. This is an off-datasheet use: the data sheets state charge-current accuracy for 10 mOhm only and the PSYS function for 10 and 20 mOhm, so the accuracy at 5 mOhm is not stated. Live stock 2026-10-02T12:25:06Z to 12:25:21Z: C188229 5436, C965493 1680, C2864000 1857, C2878935 286, C2863640 71 (all above the gate of 50).

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Cell balancing: its balancing belongs to a charger dropped under Pack charger for lacking a power path
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The reason is a dependency on another function's drop, not a Cell balancing requirement value. Re-read SLUSD89B (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25887.pdf, 2026-10-02T12:21:42Z): balance current is set by RCBSET up to 400 mA (above 84.6 mA), auto or manual mode over I2C. Whether it balances 'without the charger doing it' (charger idle, no VBUS) is not stated; its balancing is tied to the charge state machine (VCBEN 3.65 to 3.75 V per cell, charge disabled during the voltage measurement). The part is neither shown to pass nor shown to fail on a value.

missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md names it as its own row ('0 C lower and 55 C upper limit, read from a 10 kOhm, B 3435 K NTC; thresholds: a follow-up of R7; its action on discharge at the limits is a follow-up of R7's'). P2 returns no entry for it: the NTC appears only as a requirement inside Pack overcurrent protection and Pack charger, with no threshold setting, no discharge action at the limits and no part for the NTC read. The NTC part and its lead's connector are stage 2.
